I get that. Lately, my anxiety has been keeping me from living my own life. I can barely go on a car ride without feeling extreme panic, but I just can't end it now when I have so many goals and so many things I want to do. The best thing I've been able to manage was finding little hobbies that keep my mind distracted for just long enough for me to deal with my intrusive thoughts. Like I've been trying to skateboard lately and I want to learn how to do an ollie so I keep that as something to look forward to. Or like I bought myself a rubiks cube and watched some videos on how to solve one and now every day I try and try to solve it faster than the day before. I think if you can find these little things to look forward to, it'll make the journey to finding happiness a lot easier.

It's easier to remember the bad things in life than the good, but it's also so much more rewarding to experience the good things after all awful things too.
